annotations.title: Connect an AI agent to a model provider

description: osirAgentConfigure: Connect the user's AI agent (e.g. Hermes) to a model provider - 'connect my Hermes to DeepSeek'. Providers: deepseek, openai, openrouter, anthropic. The API key is stored as an encrypted secret, never written into a file or shown again, and the agent restarts on the user's VPS with it. Never paste the key anywhere else. Requires authentication.

agentId.description: Agent id from osirAgentList or osirAgentDeploy.

apiKey.description: The user's API key for that provider. Never logged or returned.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: osirAgentConfigure
